title: Gate-Based Quantum Simulation of Finite-Temperature Open-System Dynamics: A Post-Processing Reconstruction Approach for Collision Models
summary: Simulating open-system dynamics on gate-based quantum computers offers a route to exploring dissipative quantum phenomena through programmable quantum processing. Collision models provide a direct and flexible framework by representing the environment through sequential system--ancilla collisions. At finite temperatures, however, they typically require repeated preparation of thermal ancillas, adding circuit overhead and gate errors.
